confidence_notes: Restaurant meal anchors triangulate Numbeo data (via Expatica, dated June 2026), Expatarrivals and Expatistan aggregates, so they are the most reliable. Beer, cocktail and wine anchors are weakly sourced: searches found only happy-hour prices (beer about $6-7, wine about $8-10, cocktails about $9-11), so regular-menu prices are an uplift from those, with the cocktail and wine figures set by local price relationship to beer. The coffee anchor has no sourced price and rests on general knowledge. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for a July 2026 window, not based on inspected live listings or current bookings. The FX observation (0.6976 USD per AUD, dated 2026-11-03) comes from secondary reporting of the RBA reference rate, not from the RBA table itself, and it may not be the latest published observation. The source_url is the RBA exchange-rates page where the series is published; I did not verify the figure on that page.
comparable_city_reasoning: No foreign comparable city was needed. Tampa is a US metro, so anchors are based on US mid-sized metro and Florida price levels, cross-checked against Tampa-specific restaurant aggregates.
